routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/19 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.answer: From now on, let's make it a rule that ~.
Apart from ~, is there anything else (that) ~?

items.prompt: (필요성·금액의) 타당한 이유를 대다 — give a reason 대신

cover_practice.prompt: 간소화하다: Please s_________ the approval process. Three signatures are too many.
기준: Suppliers must meet three c_______: price, quality and delivery time.
다시 발생하다: The same leak may r____ in the rainy season if we repair only one spot.
배상 책임이 있는: Who is l_____ for the cost if the machine breaks during the test?
품의를 올리기 전에 견적 비교표에 대한 의견을 듣고 싶습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: I'd like your input on the quotation comparison before I submit the PR.

cover_practice.prompt: 11월 20일에 요청한 보험증권을 아직 받지 못했습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: I have yet to receive the insurance certificate, which I asked for on Nov 20.

words.meaning: (절차·양식을) 간소화하다 — make it simple / easier 대신
words.example: I streamlined the ledger so that it is easier to fill in.
words.collocations: streamline the process / streamline the form

words.meaning: (평가·선정) 기준 — rule / standard 대신 (복수형, 단수는 criterion)
words.example: The old KPI form had no clear criteria for setting targets.
Please tell me how we will make sure this does not recur.
words.collocations: prevent it from recurring / a recurring problem

words.meaning: (법적으로) 배상 책임이 있는 — responsible / must pay 대신
words.example: The trucking company is liable for any damage to the cargo during transport.
words.collocations: be liable for ~ / hold A liable

patterns.pattern: I'd like your input on ~ before I ~.
patterns.meaning: ~하기 전에 ~에 대한 의견을 듣고 싶습니다 (Could you review it first? 대신, 내보내기 전에 의견을 구할 때)
patterns.skeleton: I'd like your input on + [명사] + before + [주어][동사]
patterns.email: I'd like your input on the new KPI form before I send it to the team leaders.
patterns.spoken: Can you take a look before I send it out?

patterns.meaning: ~가 다시 ~하지 않도록 ~해 주세요 (so this does not happen again 대신, 재발 방지 조치를 지시할 때)
patterns.email: To prevent the certificates from expiring again, please add the expiry dates to the training plan.
patterns.spoken: So it doesn't happen again, put the dates in the plan.

patterns.pattern: I have yet to receive ~, which I asked for on ~.
patterns.meaning: ~에 요청한 ~을 아직 받지 못했습니다 (You have not sent ~ 대신, 상대를 탓하지 않고 재촉할 때)
patterns.skeleton: I have yet to receive + [명사], which + [주어][동사]
patterns.email: I have yet to receive the trucking quotation sheets, which I asked for on Nov 19.
patterns.spoken: I still haven't got the quotation sheets.

source: 11/21 보낸 메일(평가 양식 개편 검토 요청, 교육 인증 만료 질의, 운송 계약 책임 조항, 원장 양식 간소화, 기한 지난 자료 재촉)에서 고름.
